```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"America's history of using public policy and private lending restrictions to close neighborhoods off to Black families and other people of color and strip equity from their communities is long, painful, and unresolved to this day.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration has made matters worse by gutting fair lending and fair housing protections for homeowners.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will vigorously enforce the Fair Housing Act, the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act, the Affirmatively Furthering Fair Housing rule, and the disparate impact standard.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will hold lenders accountable for discriminatory practices.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure that federal housing programs are better designed to affirmatively further fair housing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will use the federal government to enforce settlements against discriminatory lenders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will require communities to proactively review housing patterns and remedy local policies that have a discriminatory effect.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to ensure that residential property and mortgage ownership records are publicly available and easily accessible, so that homeowners can always know who services their mortgage and who truly owns their debt.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will give local elected officials tools and resources to combat gentrification.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will penalize predatory lending practices.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will maintain homeownership.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will explore targeted rental relief when exorbitant rent increases force long-term residents from their communities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will tackle persistent racial bias in appraisals that contributes to the racial wealth gap.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
